seed: Objects of type `target` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [reflection] show mixed outcomes: h,pixels,w,y x1, h,pixels,w,x,y x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Single-axis mirror game on a 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks, parsed from frame colours (axis 10, target 11, piece 5, reflection 4, background 9).
A1/A2 move the selected axis or piece one block row; A3/A4 move a selected piece one column (no-op when the axis is selected); pieces are blocked by the board edge and other pieces.
Reflections of piece blocks land at row 2A-r and skip piece-occupied and off-board blocks; A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis.
HUD column 63 turns one 11 into 12 per action that changes the board; no hidden state needed.
Target A3 mixed-field hint: A3 is not a click, and the target field changes come from re-extraction when a piece covers it. Unconfirmed: whether the axis is blocked by piece rows, and ordering of equal-sized pieces in the A5 cycle.
